results.title: A Sliver of Truth
results.overview: One day, a man happens to witness a woman eating insects alone. A few weeks later, she approaches him for advice on a screenplay she is writing. The story is about a pervert who becomes sexually aroused by eating insects and is eventually caught by someone.

results.title: My Son’s Sugar Mama
results.overview: A protective mother discovers a wealthy, older woman is showering her young son with gifts and money. As she sets out to expose her, she discovers the woman's obsession with her son is far more dangerous than she ever could have imagined.

results.title: Gece Köpekleri
results.overview: A minor mistake made during a small-scale robbery attempted by three friends causes the entire night to spiral into a complicated and inescapable mess.

results.title: Could Have
results.overview: Your eyelids could have been a fortress  for those beautiful eyes of yours.  You could have seen once more  how far the traces of your footsteps had reached.

results.title: Rate My Ex
results.overview: Jonathan prepares for a date with Penny, a girl he recently met, when she accidently sends a confusing text. She immediately deletes it, making Jonathan suspicious. He searches her name online and he stumbles upon a website called ‘RateMyEx.com’, where he finds numerous reviews from her former exes. With the reviews in mind, Jonathan contemplates whether the date is even worth going on anymore.

results.title: Native Sin
results.overview: A Native American priest and his medicine woman sister must set aside old resentments to unite faith and tradition against a vengeful spirit.

results.title: Nail Polish
results.overview: A young woman, confined by the claustrophobic walls of her room, forms an intrusive thought and quickly spirals into a frenzy of overindulgence and self-destruction.

results.title: The Big André Severo
results.overview: Some teenagers are trying to do a documentary about André Severo, the biggest artist from the serra gaúcha.

results.title: HUELLAS. Echoes of State Terrorism in Mar del Plata 50 Years On
results.original_title: HUELLAS. A 50 años del golpe en Mar del Plata
results.overview: Can the sea wash everything away? Huellas reconstructs the circuit of state terrorism in Mar del Plata, 50 years after the civic-military coup. Through the testimonies of survivors, family members and specialists, the documentary probes the indelible marks left by repression and the resilience of a community that demands memory. Because history never ends, it is written.

results.title: Fuego amigo
results.overview: Andrés is a veteran of the Malvinas War. He works at the family transportation company. News arrives that the EAAF?the Argentine Forensic Anthropology Team?has identified the remains of his friend Damián, who fell in battle. He has started smoking again. A delegation is being organized to travel to the Islands and attend the ceremony. An old pang of guilt torments him: when Damián fell, he was a few meters behind him, firing his weapon. He always knew it wasn?t him, but the specter of friendly fire casts a shadow over his memory.

results.title: The Diego Nobody Saw
results.overview: An intimate documentary about Diego Armando Maradona, told from a unique perspective: through the eyes of someone who quietly stood by his side, capturing moments the world had never seen. Through exclusive photos and private videos, the film reveals Diego beyond the stadium and the myth, showing his most human side. For years, Jorge Luengo witnessed defining and everyday moments of Maradona?s life.

results.title: Forever Mom
results.overview: Leonora is an overwhelmed mother of two young girls and an architect whose career has been put on hold. While her husband works all day, she carries the weight of raising their children and the quiet feeling that she has lost herself somewhere along the way. One afternoon, in the middle of her daughter?s birthday party, she drives away, leaving behind the noise and contradictions of motherhood.
